item.title: A Wholesome Gift
item.content:encoded:
Sandbox link, clocking in at around 2k words.

+ Spoilers?
- Close

The main plot follows the story of Xasbo, a guy who adores cats, until at one of the festivals, he unknowingly consumes his own cat in part due to a tradition in some parts of China which practise the culture of eating cat meat, leading to his disillusionment. The practice itself isn't widely practised, and it's more centered within the Guangdong and Guangxi provinces, so the latter was the first pick of where the massacre happened. After the villagers die, the place somehow got the anomalous power to serve as a place for housing cats.

You can probably say he's more of the extreme of the extreme, PETA activist who cares nothing for humankind.

Main concerns are SPaG, whether the interview is a huge exposition dump, whether Xasbo's personality can mirror more of a subtly psychopathic character, and whether it ends on a sufficiently spooky note in contrast to Xasbo's view of a literal massacre as a festive occasion for the cats.

item.title: The Flight of the Koalas
item.description: A tale about the emergency evacuation of koalas using flying serpents.
item.content:encoded:
Word Count: 2,371

Link: http://scpdsandbox.wikidot.com/veraltanic-page-3-0

Hello everyone! This is Veralta once again completing a draft that I hope to publish as a New Year's gift! I have written a social commentary about koalas, how they and the aboriginal Australians have been affected by the bushland fires, and how people should be more ecologically-minded. I also featured a trip throughout Australia's rich culture and locations, with several of the article's parts being based on Dreamtime1 lore.

Note: I have tried to make the parts of the article that I have based on Dreamtime to be as least abstract as possible, and clear. If there are questions or ambiguity that you can find about them, feel free to mention it in the critique!

Here are the points that I want to be reviewed:

1. Is the pacing and narrative good enough?
2. Is the worldbuilding and attention to detail decent and palatable?
3. Does it sound too preachy?
4. If applicable, have you noticed several problems and contradictions with Dreamtime lore and aboriginal beliefs?2

All in all, I hope you enjoy this SCP in time for the New Year (and a new leaf for all of us)! Thank you to those who will review this!

Footnotes
1. Umbrella term for aboriginal Australian beliefs.
2. I have researched this part as much as possible, so I would like to not screw up something here.

item.title: Star Euthanizer
item.description: A 2k word draft about a spacecraft and its passenger. Any critique is welcome.
item.content:encoded:
The draft is about a spacecraft and being roaming trough space and collecting stars. It needs some chipping away for sure. It has 3 list pages (a lot gets repeated but the total word count is 2k).

The main things I want your opinion on

  • Is the second listpage good enough to be there or should I only include the first and last one? Or can I do something better for the transition? Keeping it.
  • Is the dialogue good? The messages take a long time to get an answer in both ways but I want to know if it is good since I am bad at writing dialogue for the most part.
  • Is the twist pulled off successfully?

Anyone reading for specifics only (clinical tone, SP&G,…) is always welcome.

Link to the draft

Thanks in advance.
